# OPBX

> OPBX is an open-source (MIT) business PBX built on the Cloudonix CPaaS. It connects AI voice agents and human teams on one phone system: extensions, ring groups, call queues, IVR menus, business hours, AI assistants, an auto dialer and a browser web phone. Cloudonix handles SIP, media and telephony; OPBX decides call routing in real time.

OPBX can be self-hosted for free on your own infrastructure (Docker), or used as a managed cloud service. Every page of this site is also available as Markdown, linked below. The full text of all of them is in one file at [/llms-full.txt](/llms-full.txt).

## Pages

- [OPBX homepage](/index.html.md): what OPBX is, features, how it works, pricing and FAQ
- [Install & Upgrade OPBX](/install.md): self-host OPBX with the guided installer, start, stop, upgrade, troubleshoot
- [Terms of Use](/terms.md): terms for OPBX Cloud and the open-source software

## Get started

- [Create an account](/ui/register): sign up for the managed OPBX cloud service
